writing.exampleCaption: Adding a variant breaks every match that does not handle it.
writing.explanation: match forces every variant to be handled, so adding a new state turns every incomplete match into a compile error instead of a silent bug. Variants can carry data, which lets one type model a whole state machine rather than a bag of loosely related fields.
writing.feedback: A catch-all removes the compiler's help exactly when you add a state.
